TIDUS_OVERDRIVE.title: Overdrive
TIDUS_OVERDRIVE.description:
At 100 Overdrive, unleash an Overdrive attack. 

Gain 5 Overdrive at the start of your turn.
Gain 3 Overdrive whenever you play an Attack.
Gain 6 Overdrive whenever you trigger a [blue]Blitz[/blue] effect from discard.
TIDUS_OVERKILL.title: Overkill
TIDUS_OVERKILL.description: When a killing blow deals damage equal to or greater than 20% of the target's Max HP, gain 10 additional Gold and 1 additional card reward option at the end of combat. If the target was an Act Boss, gain an additional Relic. Only works on non-minion creatures.
